connector.name: Billy MCP
connector.registryDescription: Billy (billy.dk) accounting: invoices, journal entries, trial balance, with write protection.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package billy-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the thourum account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: BILLY_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: Billy API access token (create at mit.billy.dk -> Settings -> Access tokens)

env.name: BILLY_WRITE_MODE
env.description: Write protection: read-only, confirm (default, requires elicitation-capable host), or full

env.name: BILLY_ORGANIZATION_ID
env.description: Billy organization ID (auto-resolved when the token maps to a single company)

env.name: BILLY_LOCALE
env.description: Response language: en_US, da_DK, fr_FR, nl_NL, or de_DE
